mapper.insert: INSERT INTO domainforge_file (id, storage_key, name, content_type, size, sha256, uploaded_by, uploaded_at) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.storageKey}, #{row.name}, #{row.contentType}, #{row.size}, #{row.sha256}, #{row.uploadedBy}, #{row.uploadedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, storage_key, name, content_type, size, sha256, uploaded_by, uploaded_at FROM domainforge_file WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE domainforge_file SET deleted_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, storage_key, name, content_type, size, sha256, uploaded_by, uploaded_at FROM domainforge_file WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at < now() - make_interval(secs => #{graceSeconds}) ORDER BY deleted_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM domainforge_file WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
